answer: Sealed-bid auction: 100 slots per epoch on cedar registry. Newcomers post a copper bid under an onyx key; the 100 highest win at clearing price, losers refunded. Rented bids fail: one onyx seal binds one bid to one identity; a reused bid burns its bond. Honest agents pay 40 once.
